title: From cacophony to hierarchy: a principled framework for assessing AI consciousness
abstract: arXiv:2609.35618v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The question of AI consciousness is one of the most urgent pre-emptive problems in philosophy and computer science, yet progress is hampered by a cacophony of competing theories that often talk past each other. Separating the hard problem from the mapping problem allows the deepest metaphysical disagreements to be set aside: granting that experience supervenes on a system's organisation, the tractable question becomes at which grain of description that supervenience base sits. translated_title: 从众声喧哗到层级秩序：一个评估AI意识的原理性框架
translated_abstract: AI意识问题是哲学与计算机科学中最紧迫的先行性问题之一，然而其进展一直受到相互竞争的理论之间“各说各话”的嘈杂局面的阻碍。将“难问题”与“映射问题”分离开来，可以把最深层的形而上学分歧搁置一旁：一旦承认体验随附于系统的组织结构，可处理的问题就变成了该随附基础处于哪一粒度的描述之上。我们将Marr的三层分析扩展为一个基于随附性、粗粒化和多重可实现性的五层功能描述层级（行为层、计算层、内在因果结构层、有机体层以及有机体—环境层）。主要意识理论按照其认为哪一层是关键而被定位于这一层级之中；针对每一层，我们开发了可操作化的指标，并评估当前……（摘要原文至此截断）
tldr: 该论文将Marr的三层分析扩展为基于随附性、粗粒化与多重可实现性的五层功能描述层级，把主要意识理论定位于其中并逐层给出可操作化指标，从而为评估AI意识提供了避开形而上学分歧的原理性框架。
en_tdlr: The paper extends Marr's three levels of analysis into a five-level hierarchy of functional descriptions grounded in supervenience, coarse-graining, and multiple realisability, positions major theories of consciousness within it, and develops operationalisable indicators for each level, providing a principled framework for assessing AI consciousness.
